followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the eligible Rafah passenger interruption; goods used a separate commercial route. The temporary August window includes both inward and outward passenger passage. Freight totals are not passenger reopening evidence. Retain May15 to August11,88calendar days through the first three-day passenger window. The dates are calendar boundaries, not exact elapsed hours or final normalization. Disease prevention is explicitly attributed to the Egyptian and Palestinian authorities in OCHA’s account. All three linked OCHA pages have substantive freshly read passages. They share an institutional reporting origin and are not three independent confirmations. Retain the unlocated Rafah passenger phase with null coordinates; no whole-frontier outline or precise surveyed marker is added.
